36:55.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in

36:56.text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

36:57.text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request

36:58.text: "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

36:60.text: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan -
indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

36:61.text: Me? This is a straight path.

36:62.text: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

36:63.text: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

36:64.text: burn therein today for what you used to deny."

36:65.text: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

36:66.text: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to
the path, and how could they see?

36:67.text: And if We willed, We could have deformed them,
in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

36:68.text: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;

36:69.text: And We did not give him
knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
